lessons.title: Teste de passagem
lessons.goal: Passar do B1+ para o B2.

test.prompt: The film ___ (direct) by Greta Gerwig in 2023.
They are building a new cinema.
acc: A new cinema is being built
A new cinema is being built by them

test.prompt: He has been driving for ten hours without a break. He ___ be very tired. (certeza: must / might / can't)
A man with no hair on his head is ___.
If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we ___ (stay) at home.
I'll call you as soon as I ___ (arrive).
If I ___ (have) more money, I ___ (buy) a bigger flat.
If I would have a car, I would drive to work.
acc: If I had a car I would drive to work
If I had a car I'd drive to work

test.prompt: She enjoys ___ (work) with children.
He decided ___ (leave) his job.
"I am tired," she said.
acc: She said that she was tired

test.prompt: He asked me, "Where do you live?"
acc: He asked me where I lived
He asked me where I live

test.prompt: If I ___ (study) harder, I ___ (pass) the exam.
___ (luck), nobody was hurt in the accident.
How ___ apps do you have on your phone? (much / many)
There's ___ coffee left, just enough for one cup. (a little / a few)
The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
That's the restaurant ___ we had our first date.
You're a student, ___?
She doesn't smoke, ___?

chat.scenario: Entrevista de seleção para um programa avançado de estudos no exterior.
chat.role: Entrevistador do programa, que pergunta sobre experiências, situações hipotéticas, o que você ouviu ou leu e planos.
chat.goal: Usar pelo menos 6 destas estruturas corretamente: voz passiva, dedução (must / might / can't), first, second ou third conditional, gerúndio e infinitivo, discurso indireto, quantificadores, relative clauses; e fazer 1 question tag no fim.
chat.turns: 12 a 15 trocas; a IA dá a nota no relatório final e 7 ou mais aprova

en.gram: B1+ passage test: mixed review of units 11 to 20. Grammar: passive voice, must / might / can't for deduction, first, second and third conditionals, gerund vs infinitive, reported speech, quantifiers, relative clauses, question tags.
en.vocab: Mixed vocabulary from units 11 to 20 (cinema, appearance, education, home, work, shopping, luck, technology, admired people, crime).
en.scenario: A selection interview for an advanced study-abroad program.
en.role: The interviewer of the program. Ask about experiences, hypothetical situations ("What would you do if...?", "What would you have done if...?"), things the student has heard or read, and plans. Near the end, the student should ask you one question with a question tag.
en.goal: The student uses at least 6 of these structures correctly: passive voice, deduction with must / might / can't, first, second or third conditional, gerund or infinitive, reported speech, quantifiers, relative clauses; and asks 1 question tag at the end.
